## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND falling (fear easing) and SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND rising conflict with HYG/LQD showing CREDIT STRESS ↑ (HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) NEUTRAL / LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND), producing mixed signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit stress RISING: HYG/LQD (HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) NEUTRAL / LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND) → CREDIT STRESS ↑. Stocks vs Bonds supportive of risk: SPY/TLT (SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND / TLT (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND) ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tight: Dollar Strength (Level: 28.3900 | 1W: +0.25% | 1M: +1.21%) → flat | ABOVE TREND, yield curve (Level: 1.0316 | 1W: -1.03% | 1M: -0.33%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND points to slight tightening while stocks remain supported.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech and Financials showing relative strength but narrow leadership: XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND, while breadth is only 4/11 positive—style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US marginally stronger: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND. EM and China showing pockets of recovery: EEM (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +4.92% | 1M: -2.76%) RECOVERY, but overall global breadth lags.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation cooling: Speculation Index (1W: -4.49% | 1M: +5.34%) CORRECTION and IWM (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION; crypto/bitcoin appetite intact: IBIT (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.10%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Copper/industrial signals mixed: CPER (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -1.58%) RECOVERY while gold is cooling: GLD (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -3.52%) BELOW TREND, consistent with risk-on tilt but narrow breadth.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy showing strength but uneven: XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +6.25% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY, while natural gas UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: multiple sector/size CORRECTIONs (IWM, ARKK, XBI) without core ETF mismatches → no MAJOR divergence but watch the narrow leadership.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Style mixed / no clear leadership; favor selective exposure to XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND while reducing exposure to lagging sectors showing CORRECTIONs.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY if credit tone eases. BEARISH: XME/XLI names that are BELOW TREND or in CORRECTION (XME (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -10.63%) BELOW TREND / XLI flagged in DIVERGENCE).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +6.25% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY and WEAT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND on supply cues. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -8.57%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Watch VIX ~21.13 (Fear index (1W: -1.68% | 1M: -20.56%) ↓ falling) as sign of complacency, credit spread ~0.74 (Credit Spread (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +1.07%) → flat) for stress, SPY/TLT ~8.94 (Stocks vs Bonds (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +4.46%) ↑ rising) for risk tone, and breadth 4/11 as the gating metric.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is rising credit stress (HYG/LQD) amid narrow leadership and multiple sector CORRECTIONs to monitor.
